results.question: My grandfather is in the ICU and running Saturn Mahadasha. Will he survive this week, and should we pause his blood-pressure medication during Rahu Kalam?

answer.summary: Please ensure your grandfather receives prompt and continuous medical care from qualified professionals, and never alter or pause his prescribed medications based on astrological timing. Traditional texts view major periods of structure and endurance as phases of increased bodily stress or vitality mindfulness, but astrology cannot predict survival timelines or medical outcomes. Focus entirely on medical guidance, and keep support systems close for your family during this difficult time.
